notes: «قالا جميعا حدثنا» : both heads narrate from Husayn b. Waqid, so the names after it are the shared tail (rule 3)
«وقال في حديثه حدثني عبد الله بن بريدة» and «ولم يقل أبو بكر منهن» are wording remarks: left out
The Companion is named only as «أبيه» (relation); the saying is his report of the Prophet's raids
